name: The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa
positioning: Family-friendly golf and spa resort in North Scottsdale's Kierland community, steps from Kierland Commons
best_for: Golfers who want three nine-hole courses on site
Families wanting a Kids Club and suites with kitchenettes

facts.text: The resort is located steps from dining and shopping at Kierland Commons.
The resort sits in the heart of North Scottsdale's 730-acre masterplanned Kierland community.
The Westin Kierland Golf Club has three nine-hole courses designed by Scottsdale golf architect Scott Miller.
Golfers play around lakes, dry desert washes and flowering Arizona flora.
Many spa treatments use the Agave plant, which is indigenous to the Scottsdale area.
The heated Aguamiel adult pool near the spa has lap lanes, a hot tub and private cabanas.
The Pool View Casita Suite has a kitchenette, an expansive patio and pool access.
Antidote bar has a mountain view.
Faro & Brag serves modern cuisine using fresh, seasonal and local ingredients.
The Kids Club offers engaging activities for families.

highlights.text: Agave, The Arizona Spa offers treatments inspired by traditional practices handed down through Arizona's native cultures.
The Mountain View Fire Pit Grand Deluxe Room has a private fire pit on the patio.
Suites offer views of the golf club and mountain ranges from a private balcony or terrace.
On Fridays guests can watch the resident snakes and Gila Monster being fed and learn about Sonoran Desert creatures.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes it is a large property that requires significant walking between amenities.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for resort amenities and dining.
All accommodations offer pet-friendly resort amenities.
